title: Rating Manual Rate Page — Cardinal DriveSense Per-Mile Rates, Daily Mile Cap and Base Rate
content:
Mileage rating figures for Cardinal DriveSense. Two programs are pay-per-mile: Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In.

## Rate table

| Program | Per-mile rate (cents per mile) | Most miles charged for one calendar day | Share of the vehicle's rated premium kept as the fixed base rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 100% (not pay-per-mile) |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 100% (not pay-per-mile) |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 100% (not pay-per-mile) |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 0 (not pay-per-mile) | 100% (not pay-per-mile) |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 6.4 | 250 | 45% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 5.9 | 250 | 42% |

## Mileage terms (all six programs)

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| Period over which miles are billed | The calendar month |
| How miles are estimated for days without data | Average daily miles over the last 30 days |
| Calendar days after a mileage charge within which an odometer correction is accepted | 30 |

## Rate notes

- The per-mile rate is quoted in cents: 6.4 cents per mile on Miles Mobile is $0.064 per mile, and 5.9 cents per mile on Miles Plug-In is $0.059 per mile.
- The two pay-per-mile programs share the 250-mile daily figure; they differ in the per-mile rate (6.4 against 5.9 cents) and in the base rate share (45% against 42%).
- On the four programs that are not pay-per-mile the rate and the daily figure are 0 and the base rate share is 100%, the whole rated premium.
- Illustration (hypothetical miles): 1,000 miles at 6.4 cents is 6,400 cents, or $64.00; the same 1,000 miles at 5.9 cents is 5,900 cents, or $59.00.
